title: Adi Devudu Avatharinchenu – Freddy Paul Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: ఆది దేవుడవతరించెను ఈ అవనిలో ఆది దేవుడవతరించెను
అఖిల లోక రక్షకుడై రారాజు యేసు జన్మించెను
english: Aadi devudavatharinchenu ee avanilo aadi devudavatharinchenu

intro: Adi Devudu Avatharinchenu is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned by Pastor Freddy Paul, Hosanna Ministries, Kurnool and sung by Kareemullah and music composed by Prakash Rex. This song video was released on December 06, 2022 through Hosanna Ministries Kurnool YouTube channel.
